title: Fixture Wire
description: A fixture wire that exists only to prove the renderer runs.

dispatches.lead: Power failed across Gridfall early Sunday after equipment trouble at Substation No. 3, the county said.
dispatches.body:
Roughly 1,400 customers were affected, the county said.

Crews were dispatched at about 6 a.m., according to a county spokesperson.
